rooms.name: Lake Zarovich
rooms.desc: A great lake lies under the mountain, ringed by misty forest. The water is black and dead calm, a mirror for the clouds.
rooms.dm: Daytime from the shore north of Vallaki: three rowboats are pulled up on the south shore and a fourth sits out on the lake with a lone figure fishing. Each rowboat safely holds five.

rooms.name: South shore landing
rooms.desc: A strip of muddy shingle where the Vallaki fishers pull up their boats.
rooms.dm: The three rowboats here are free for the taking; each holds five.

objects.label: Rowboat
objects.desc: A small rowboat pulled up on the shore, oars shipped. It holds five.

objects.label: Net shed
objects.desc: A fisherman's lean-to of weathered boards, nets drying on a rack beside it.

objects.label: Bluto's rowboat
objects.desc: Far out on the water a single rowboat sits motionless, someone in it holding a fishing pole.

objects.label: Bluto Krogarov (commoner)
objects.dm: A destitute Vallaki drunkard in a trance; he answers nothing unless attacked, is unarmed and neither helps nor hinders. If watched from shore for several minutes, or approached by boat, he tosses the sack overboard and waits for his fish.

objects.label: Arabelle, bound in a burlap sack (commoner, 2 hp)
objects.dm: Seven-year-old Vistana, bound with rope in the sack, lying prone so she cannot be seen or heard from shore. Once the sack goes in: DC 15 Strength (Athletics) from shore to reach her in time, DC 10 for anyone in a rowboat. Rescued, she asks to be taken to her father Luvash at the Vistani camp outside Vallaki (N9), promising a reward.

objects.label: Bluto's boat lies 400 ft from the nearest shore.
South: the track back to Vallaki (N).
